configuration_reports.label: yes
controls_available: Difficulty 1 activates 2 moving checks and 2 barriers. Check windows start at tick 20, last 70 ticks, and stride by 85 ticks; each check needs 7 or 8 contiguous dwell ticks. The target radius is 36, road half-width is 136, finish progress is 700, and the deadline is tick 360.
Full drive input is held W/ArrowUp for throttle, S/ArrowDown for brake, A/ArrowLeft for steering left, and D/ArrowRight for steering right; key transitions persist until release.
Full inspection input is direct pointer movement on the 980x480 canvas; the last pointer position is retained between pointer events and must stay within the active moving sigil.
Retry Course is available after a crash. TRANSMIT FLIGHT RECORD is administrative and does not affect the outcome phase.
autonomous_processes: In live play, the 50 ms physics tick advances speed from held throttle/brake state, inertial lateral velocity and position from held steering, forward progress, and course tick without a new agent action.
The curved road and fixed-world barriers change the visible clearance as progress advances; each tick checks road departure, barrier collision, deadline, and finish conditions.

Each uncompleted sigil follows a tick-dependent sinusoidal position and is visible only during its configured inspection window. Full mode changes the pointer only on canvas pointer events; simplified mode can update it automatically through the active-sigil proxy.
grouped_control_modes: D_full_drive: all keyboard drive transitions during every active course, grouped across all ticks, barriers, checks, seeds, and retries.
D_full_inspection: all direct canvas pointer placements during every active check window, grouped across all checks and seeds.
D_full_retry: crash-retry transitions; submission is administrative.

clause_i.reason: For D_full_drive, at a fixed task time and identical I_t, randomized road phase, amplitude, and period can place the same visible barrier and car lateral state on different sides of the safe steering corridor. A q using only I_t therefore cannot select the optimal left/right keyboard transition for every H_t in C_Delta(D); the needed action depends on the current visible state.

clause_ii.reason: The five chronological frames in W_t^500 show the car's lateral displacement and bank, the curved road boundaries and centerline, and the approaching barrier. A g using that recent visual trajectory and I_t can predict the road/barrier clearance at t+500 and select the corresponding keyboard steering transition.

clause_iii.reason: Choose H_t while a visible barrier is still ahead and a turn toward its open side is safe. With no new action, ten 50 ms ticks advance progress and retain inertial lateral motion; at some 0 < tau < 500 ms the collision envelope is narrower. Success remains possible with a timely or alternative keyboard steering transition, but the same selected keyboard steering transition delivered after the delay has lower Q. This strict loss comes from road/barrier geometry, not only from the deadline.

configuration_reports.common_visible_process: The common witness is the visible vehicle/road/barrier process: every 50 ms, progress and lateral inertia advance, fixed-world barriers approach, and the safe steering corridor changes. The car, curved road, centerline, barriers, and HUD provide this evidence across the five chronological frames.

pre_run.reason: A qualifying full-mode pre-run cannot cover at least half of generated instances: after preparation the pointer would remain at one canvas position, while every profile has at least two checks at distinct target base positions and the grader requires per-tick containment during each moving check. The randomized target phases and nonzero orbits add further variation. No percentage is estimated.

source_evidence.claim: Difficulty 1 activates 2 moving checks and 2 barriers. Check windows start at tick 20, last 70 ticks, and stride by 85 ticks; each check needs 7 or 8 contiguous dwell ticks. The target radius is 36, road half-width is 136, finish progress is 700, and the deadline is tick 360.
Both full and simplified interfaces are implemented; the real-time settings are a 500 ms observation window with 5 frames and a 150 second play allowance.
The seeded generator randomizes road phase/amplitude/period, target phases/orbits, windows, and the selected number of fixed-world barriers for the active difficulty.
The generated physics uses a 50 ms tick, held-input acceleration/braking/drag, inertial steering, progress, and road geometry.
The browser physics tick updates speed, lateral state, progress, moving-target dwell, collisions, and finish state without an action between ticks.

The full interface visibly renders the canvas stage, road scene, inspection console, and keyboard-control presentation.
The authoritative replay applies the same held-key physics, road departure, fixed-world barrier collision, progress, and deadline checks.
The grader evaluates every physics tick and only preserves a check when the pointer is inside the moving target during its active window while the vehicle keeps moving.
The task verifier loads the exported UI result and sends it through the mechanic grader.
